campaign: K3 full-12 compact union long discriminator
question: Does the still-exact full-12 union shape remain byte-identical across repeated width-eight chunks and clear the material compute/H2D gate at M_e=245?
reason_for_separate_continuation: The prior registered discriminator validly rejected six-slab identical-mask width eight before reaching the full-12 long arm. This continuation does not rerun or weaken that failed arm.

fixture.requested_masks: the same eight deterministic 1..8-slab masks from the prior discriminator, repeated in fixed order

arms_in_fixed_order: 245-row rowwise compact teacher versus one full-12 union payload reused over width-eight chunks
five-row padded-tail teacher versus full-12 width-eight union

correctness_gate.outputs: byte-identical for all 245 real rows and all five padded-tail real rows
correctness_gate.dispatch: MMVQ launches greater than zero and MMQ launches equal zero
correctness_gate.payload: authoritative candidate weight H2D equals exactly one full-12 payload

performance_gate.primary_metric: 245-row candidate_ns divided into matched rowwise teacher_ns
performance_gate.go: all correctness gates pass and speedup is at least 1.6x
performance_gate.no_go: any correctness failure or speedup below 1.6x

abort_conditions: wrong physical device or platform profile
any correctness, dispatch, or accounting failure

interpretation_boundary: A GO earns default-off layer-major integration work only. It is not a live prefill throughput claim. Full-12 compute shape does not require reading missing physical slabs: unused tensor slots may be deterministic padding because row-specific down maps never reference them; production H2D/storage accounting must still be measured.
